'''Phase Zero dark troopers''' were a variant of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] created as a result of [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] [[Cyborg/Legends|enhancements]] on [[clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as part of the [[Dark Trooper Project]]. They were the organic predecessors of the experimental [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark trooper]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].

==History==
[[File:Darktrooper_Death_Star_Uprising.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A Phase Zero dark trooper alongside regular stormtroopers during the Galactic Civil War.]]
The Phase Zero dark troopers were created in the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as part of the [[Dark Trooper Project]]<ref name="TFUCG" /> to deal with a shortage of experienced [[Troop/Legends|troops]]. The program was overseen by then-[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Rom Mohc]] and was based on the ''[[Empirical]]'', a hidden space station in the [[Dominus system/Legends|Dominus system]].<ref name="TFUCG" /> He called the program the [[Project Dark Trooper|Dark Trooper Phase Zero]].<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

To return aged veterans of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to peak condition, their limbs and organs were removed and replaced with [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] using much of the same technology used to transform [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] into a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]]. In some cases, over 70% of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]]'s body was replaced. With their years of combat experience and cybernetic enhancements, the units that did make it onto the field were undeniably effective.<ref name="TFUCG" /> 

However, as the subjects were forcibly recruited into the project, many Phase Zero Dark Troopers could not cope with the state of being more machine than man and attempted suicide. The project was eventually shut down as the Empire grew in power and the recruitment rate of non-clones rose. Although the project was shut down, it was eventually reactivated by Rom Mohc, who had become a [[General/nds|general]].<ref name="TFUCG" />

Phase Zero dark troopers fought during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Rumors spread that the [[Armor/Legends|armored]], lethal individuals were not just mere humans or [[Droid/Legends|droids]], but enhanced cyborgs.<ref name="BF I" />

==Equipment==
They were outfitted with [[blast cannon]]s, [[SE-14r light repeating blaster/Legends|SE-14r light repeating blasters]], [[Baradium-core code key thermal detonator|thermal detonators]], [[ARC caster]]s, and [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|commando blaster pistols]]. They also had a [[jump pack]].<ref name="BF I" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
The Phase Zero Dark Troopers first appeared in the [[Star Wars Battlefront (series)|''Star Wars: Battlefront'']] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] series as the Empire's specialized class. In the [[Star Wars: Battlefront|first game]], they utilized the blast cannon and [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] as their sidearm, while they are equipped with the ARC caster along with commando blaster pistols as their sidearm weapon in ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''. They also had jump packs in order to travel quickly on the battlefield.
